meta.title: GRN Photo / Document Attachment: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: GRN Photo / Document Attachment behavior on a GRN, including refusal or absence for a non-Warehouse Executive and availability for a Warehouse Executive; role-specific sign-in and tenant RBAC configuration are also unavailable
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: GRN Photo / Document Attachment behavior on a GRN, including refusal or absence for a non-Warehouse Executive and availability for a Warehouse Executive; role-specific sign-in and tenant RBAC configuration are also unavailable

args.need: sign in as a non-Warehouse Executive and as a Warehouse Executive in the same Enterprise tenant, open a GRN, attempt to attach photos or documents in each session, and record whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach a GRN or switch between users with different Warehouse Executive roles.
Final assertion required by the plan format; it only checks that the resulting screen has no crash or raw error and does not establish the GRN permission behavior.
